title: Trajectory-Relative Hindsight Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Trajectory-Relative Hindsight Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning｜Recent agentic reinforcement learning methods use hindsight to complement sparse outcome rewards. Howe

extra.description: Recent agentic reinforcement learning methods use hindsight to complement sparse outcome rewards. However, a completed rollout can yield many such signals, leaving their appropriate allocation across turns unclear. We introduce TRIAL, a trajectory-relative hindsight distillation framework with a unified turn-aligned scoring protocol.
